children: Nordic markets are seen opening slightly higher on Friday, with IG calling the OMXS30 up 0.4% at around 3335. U.S. stock markets were cheerful Thursday and Nvidia's good numbers have helped to breathe new life into the AI trade and lower concerns about a possible bubble and over-investment, SEB senior economist Johan Javeus writes. However, there is also caution ahead of Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's speech later Friday, he says. "We are also keeping a close eye on Iceland's referendum tomorrow on whether the country should resume negotiations to join the EU." Asian stock markets are mostly higher while futures point higher in Europe and flat in the U.S. OMXS30 closed at 3321.44, OMXN40 at 2730.83 and OBX at 2013.51. (dominic.chopping@wsj.com)
